UPDATE "RoutingRule" SET name = $2, description = $3, enabled = $4, priority = $5,
                  type = $6, domain = $7, ip = $8, port = $9, "sourcePort" = $10, source = $11,
                  protocol = $12, "inboundTag" = $13, "outboundTag" = $14, "balancerTag" = $15,
                  "subRules" = $16, "nodeScope" = $17, "updatedAt" = $18
           WHERE id = $1
